info.title: group.proto
info.description:
Group Service provides CRUD operations for managing permission groups.
A Group is a collection of permissions that can be assigned to Roles.

Groups serve as organizational containers for related permissions.
For example, an "invoice-management" group might contain permissions
for reading, writing, and deleting invoices.

Roles are always created within a specific Group, and a Role's
permissions must be a subset of its parent Group's permissions
(the Subset Constraint).

get.summary: ListGroups returns a paginated list of all groups.

parameters.name: pagination.limit
parameters.description: The number of items per page

parameters.name: pagination.orderBy
parameters.description: what field to use for ordering

post.summary: CreateGroup creates a new permission group.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: CreateGroupRequest contains the fields needed to create a new group.

get.summary: ListGroupPermissions returns all permissions assigned to a group.

parameters.name: groupUid
parameters.description: group_uid identifies which group's permissions to list.

parameters.name: pagination.limit
parameters.description: The number of items per page

parameters.name: pagination.orderBy
parameters.description: what field to use for ordering

post.summary: AssignGroupPermission adds a permission to a group.

parameters.name: groupUid
parameters.description: group_uid identifies which group to receive the permission.

delete.summary: RevokeGroupPermission removes a permission from a group.

parameters.name: groupUid
parameters.description: group_uid identifies which group to modify.

parameters.name: permissionUid
parameters.description: permission_uid identifies which permission to revoke.

get.summary: GetGroup retrieves a group by its public UID.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: uid is the public unique identifier of the group.

delete.summary:
DeleteGroup permanently removes a group by its UID.
This will cascade to delete all roles within the group.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: uid identifies which group to delete.

put.summary: UpdateGroup modifies an existing group's details.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: uid identifies which group to update.

permissionUid.description: permission_uid identifies which permission to assign.

uid.description:
uid is the public unique identifier for this permission.
This UUID is used in API requests and remains stable across
database migrations or internal ID changes.

resource.description:
resource identifies the domain entity this permission applies to.
Examples: "invoices", "users", "settings", "reports"
Must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens/underscores.

action.title:
action specifies the operation allowed on the resource.
Common values: "read", "write", "delete", "admin"

description.description:
description provides a human-readable explanation of this permission's
scope and purpose, useful for admin UI display and audit logs.

createdAt.description: created_at is the Unix timestamp (seconds) when this permission was created.

permissionPermission.description:
Permission represents a granular access control unit.
It defines what action can be performed on a specific resource.
